title: mail_sent output
description: A day's sent mail of the caller's own person.

node.description: The person's node it was read on.

messages.description: The messages, in the order they were sent.

Road.description: The road a day's sent mail was read on.

oneOf.description: The running classic Outlook on the person's machine.
Microsoft Graph, with the token the page-token service lends for the person.

SentMessage.description: One message sent: its subject, when it was sent and to whom; never its body or its attachments.

sentAt.description: When it was sent, in epoch milliseconds.

Recipient.description: One recipient of a sent message.

address.description: The address, an Exchange recipient's SMTP address where one is held; none where the road gave none.

RecipientKind.description: Whether a recipient was written to, copied or blind-copied.
